name: Inceltred
source:
Guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts.

They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together.

Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
盖伊正计划与他的女朋友会面，利用他们分享的照片通过挑衅性的帖子来恶作剧访客。

他们都是喜欢一起出去玩的蛰居族，但环境不允许他们住在一起。

由于过去的创伤，他们必须经历一段艰难的适应新的、陌生的生活的旅程。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422120/]Steam[/url]]
